outcome: First antenatal care booking before 16 weeks of gestation
cohort: Adolescent (15-19 years old) and adult (20-34 years old) women who attended randomly selected health facilities in East Gojjam zone, Northwest Ethiopia (n = 1254)
finding: Adolescent pregnancy was associated with higher odds of postpartum depression and lower odds of undergoing cesarean section and assisted vaginal delivery compared to adult women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section and assisted vaginal delivery were significantly lower among adolescent women.
